Guard/security post buyer segment — siblings Guard Huts (42751) and PVC Guard Huts (132218) serve security-post buyers; names referencing guard huts or security cabins are blocked.

Container home buyer segment — sibling Container Homes (96542) carves out shipping-container conversion buyers; 'container home' or 'container house' as a standalone primary descriptor is blocked (term retained only as a product_type within broader residential context).
